effective_or_revised: Effective 02|01|2019; last updated 07|16|2020; Provider Updates through December 2020
criteria_location: Medical Criteria p.1 (three bullets) and Policy Statement pp.1-2. Criteria text is stated before the policy statement that refers back ('when the criteria above is met').
procedures_covered: Percutaneous LAAC with FDA-approved device (e.g., Watchman), 33340
Other devices (Lariat, Amplatzer) not medically necessary
BlueCHiP for Medicare: only within a CMS-approved clinical trial

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Other devices not medically necessary because not FDA approved.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: There is an increased risk of stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 score, or CHA2DS2-VASc score and; Systemic anticoagulation therapy is recommended, and; The long-term risks of systemic anticoagulation outweigh the risks of the device implantation
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Bullets chained with 'and;' and 'and,' - the 'or' joins two scores inside bullet one; the trailing 'and' is placed at the line end, so the nesting is by punctuation.

requirement_kinds.quote: increased risk of stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 score, or CHA2DS2-VASc score

patients enrolled in a Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) approved clinical trial
Prior authorization is recommended and obtained via the online tool for participating providers.
